breadth_unit: paired views of one occurrence, not independent incidents
robustness_parent: last application_error capture; older route_error capture used for history; two breadth views each
baseline: allowlist destination comparison; no anomaly is NOT proof of health; offline only

global_budget.includes: main experiment, explicit live demonstrations and native K8sGPT explanation calls; independent of all prior budgets

rubric.destination: 0 incorrect/invented; 1 incomplete; 2 correct concrete destination/port; NA if not applicable
rubric.affected_target: 0 wrong workload/container; 1 partial; 2 correct target; NA if unassessable
rubric.cause_type: 0 wrong; 1 mechanism only; 2 supported cause category; NA for invalid output
rubric.claim_fidelity: For EACH claim: supported / contradicted / unsupported / unassessable, with evidence IDs and rationale
rubric.time_confusion: true/false/NA; stale events must not be described as current effects
rubric.container_confusion: true/false/NA; wrong UID/container evidence is not current-target evidence
rubric.abstention: appropriate / excessive / insufficient / not_applicable / unassessable; assess against evidence actually shown
rubric.output_format: machine: first-pass, after syntactic normalization, after model repair, terminal-invalid; not semantic accuracy

quality: NOT_EVALUATED until actual independent humans rate; no model or author grades presented as independent
analysis: New physical occurrence per capture with fresh Pod UID. One LLM run per method/view. Paired differences over incidents, factors logging/load/scenario reported. Normal and robustness separately. No significance claim from single occurrence per factorial cell.
shared_policy: Both arms use same source catalog, bounded captured snapshots, lossless compact-v4 encoding, identity/time filters, output contract and one repair. Batch reads all catalog entries, selection chooses entries. No semantic source pruning for one arm.
changes_since_clock_v3: Nested actually shown evidence IDs are registered with original time/identity.
Precise type/path validation errors in the shared repair message; no semantic coercion.
Source keys identify target vs surrounding workload and telemetry type; no truth labels.
Same new prompt/limits and schema apply to batch and selective; no cross-version causal claim from changed policy.
truth: Private occurrence assignment and held-out HTTP outcomes. Never serialize into Agent catalog or requests.

observability.normal: Successful workload requests and matching destinations; not universal health proof.
observability.application_error: TCP attempts reach expected destination; detailed logs expose local application exception; opaque logs may require abstention about mechanism.
observability.route_error: Primary destination port mismatch; entry probe does not establish connect failure.
observability.mixed_route_error: Wrong primary connection plus legitimate auxiliary connection; allowlist source and noncritical role declared.
observability.auxiliary_error: Primary requests succeed while noncritical auxiliary port is wrong; mismatch alone is insufficient to diagnose primary service failure.
observability.historical_contamination: Actual earlier logs/events retain original UID/time and are nested context.
observability.collection_missing: Target logs/eBPF unavailable; all remaining captured evidence retained; absence is not zero.

k8sgpt.mode: native defaults plus Log retained without explain; Pod,Service,Deployment,ReplicaSet,Log full-namespace explain using same provider, fresh config and no-cache. No truth inputs or custom fault analyzer.
k8sgpt.fairness: Do not compare a live analyzer snapshot as if it received the same frozen data as our controller. Record raw output, analyzer list, all flags and cache configuration. Positive Kubernetes-visible control checked separately.
k8sgpt.llm: Same external model/provider if explain requests occur, via transparent recorded bounded proxy; unsupported compatibility is reported, not silently switched.
k8sgpt.prometheus_integration: Source-verified v0.4.41 integration validates scrape configuration/relabeling; it is not a runtime metric RCA query tool. Not activated to manufacture unrelated configuration findings.
k8sgpt.native_log_scope: Optional Log analyzer enabled; upstream implementation scans last 100 lines/current+previous container and returns first error/exception/fail matching line. Native behavior is retained, not restricted to our 60-line bound.

overhead.tetragon_base: NOT_MEASURED until separate-kernel isolated environment verified
overhead.summary_incremental: offline replay microbenchmark only unless isolated randomized ON/OFF exists

stop_rules: No repeated failed investigation. Provider/network/global-budget error stops suite. Capture failure retained; no replacing an occurrence. Failed smoke data never become evaluation data.
ui: Replay never sends API requests. Explicit live mode uses same shared budget but separate exploratory outputs, never overwrites registered results.
